nodes.title: Task + workspace
nodes.subtitle: START · one active writer
nodes.body: The runner binds a task, acceptance criteria, workspace, effective configuration, and stable thread identity. One task owns the working tree in Stage 1.
facts: This is graph input, not an extra agent.
New tasks get their own budget and state lifecycle.

nodes.title: Prepare context
nodes.subtitle: node 1 · bounded request
nodes.body: Checks task limits and constructs a provider-independent request view from task state and external artifacts. Preserve instructions, current patch/check evidence, and complete tool-call/result pairs.
facts: Paginate reads and spool large tool output.
Compact completed history only when pressure requires it.
Do not lose task identity or limits when changing models.

nodes.title: Select inference route
nodes.subtitle: node 2 · ordinary code
nodes.body: Selects the next model using phase, capability, context fit, endpoint health, budget, and cloud permission. The first hybrid policy permits bounded local discovery and keeps cloud sticky after escalation.
facts: No paid supervisor/classifier call on every turn.
Host-observed failures beat model self-confidence.
Unavailable required cloud inference stops or pauses honestly.

nodes.title: One inference gateway
nodes.subtitle: node 3 · same agent state
nodes.body: Calls the selected model adapter, records usage and latency, normalizes the response, and determines whether there are tool calls, a completion candidate, or a bounded recoverable failure.
facts: Local/cloud endpoints are services, not independent agents.
Every retry attempt is accounted for.
Provider-specific request conversion must preserve valid call/result structure.

nodes.title: Local endpoint
nodes.subtitle: bounded discovery policy
nodes.body: The initial hybrid policy advertises only search/read during eligible discovery. A small allowance limits extra turns before cloud handover. Model/runtime choices remain open until hardware is known.
facts: Input must fit this model's actual context/output budget.
Do not execute a mutation because the local model guessed another tool name.

nodes.title: Cloud endpoint
nodes.subtitle: implementation / recovery
nodes.body: Handles implementation, difficult recovery, and final reasoning in the first hybrid policy. It receives a compatible view of the existing task, not a fresh agent with forgotten history.
facts: Requires configured data-sharing permission and budget.
Sticky selection limits routing churn and repeated transfer.

nodes.title: Validate + authorize
nodes.subtitle: node 4 · before effects
nodes.body: Validates tool name, arguments, IDs, scope, and effective authority. Applies deterministic policy and pauses for approval when needed. Denials return matched observations and may trigger escalation.
facts: An approval applies to the exact operation/input hash.
Keep effects outside the pre-interrupt portion of this node.
Do not equate a tool schema with safe command semantics.

nodes.title: Human decision
nodes.subtitle: durable interrupt / resume
nodes.body: The host presents the proposed action and resumes the same thread with a decision. The node can restart from its beginning, so approval handling must be free of earlier effects.
facts: Unattended mode needs a reject/allow/pause policy.
A persisted decision is not a broad future capability grant.

nodes.title: Execute approved tools
nodes.subtitle: node 5 · serial effects
nodes.body: Calls the capability runtime for the approved batch. Model actions append paired results; configured host checks record typed evidence and return directly to verification.
facts: Four built-ins: search, read_file, apply_patch, run_command.
Unknown mutation outcomes require inspection, not blind retry.
Invalidate relevant verification after mutations.

nodes.title: Configured MCP adapter
nodes.subtitle: optional existing client
nodes.body: When required by a task, manage one configured server through the same capability contract. Filter a small read-only catalog; reuse an existing transport/client implementation.
facts: Connect/discover/call/close belongs to kernel resource ownership.
The graph does not require MCP for ordinary repository work.

nodes.title: Run + artifact store
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint / events / ledger
nodes.body: A persistent checkpointer tracks graph state. An event record and operation ledger retain execution evidence; artifact storage keeps large content outside messages.
facts: External effects are not rolled back by a checkpoint.
Keep credentials and live clients out of serialized state.

nodes.title: Check completion evidence
nodes.subtitle: node 6 · no reviewer agent
nodes.body: A local no-tool response closes discovery and escalates. A cloud candidate is checked against current evidence. Missing configured checks go through guard/execute and return here without another inference.
facts: Stale evidence after an edit cannot validate completion.
Host checks are evidence events, not unmatched tool messages.
Bound repair loops and allow an honest blocked/failed outcome.

nodes.title: Persist outcome → END
nodes.subtitle: node 7 · truthful status
nodes.body: Records final patch/evidence references, usage, routing decisions, and completion status. END can mean completed, failed, blocked, or budget-stopped; it must not imply success in every case.
facts: Attach exact checked revision/workspace identity where possible.
No unmeasured quality or savings claim.

nodes.title: Generate Plan
nodes.subtitle: Cloud model
nodes.body: The cloud model can give plan to the future actions for the small models to perform (think of it like the pm in a sprint meeting
facts: Diagram design only; implementation remains to be defined.

nodes.title: Local Model Action Queue
nodes.subtitle: User-added component
nodes.body: A queue set of local model actions to be performed or just completed, much like "the program" in a traditional process
facts: Diagram design only; implementation remains to be defined.

edges.label: begin / resume
edges.body: The host supplies or resumes serializable task state under a stable thread identity.
edges.payload: Task, workspace, acceptance criteria, configuration and limits.

edges.label: request fits policy
edges.body: The prepared context and remaining resources become inputs to deterministic selection.
edges.payload: Phase, context size/capabilities, health, budget and recent failures.

edges.label: selected model
edges.body: A successful route selects one adapter inside the same inference node. This is not agent delegation.
edges.payload: Model key, route reason and provider-specific request settings.

edges.label: selected: local
edges.body: The gateway invokes the local endpoint for a policy-eligible discovery request and normalizes its response.
edges.payload: Bounded context plus read/search schema; response and usage.

edges.label: selected: cloud
edges.body: The same gateway invokes cloud after eligibility, data-sharing and budget checks. Existing task state is retained.
edges.payload: Compatible context/tool schema; response and usage.

edges.label: tool calls
edges.body: A parsed proposal goes through policy before any effect. Invalid/malformed output is handled under bounded repair rules.
edges.payload: Assistant message, named calls, arguments and IDs.

edges.label: allowed calls
edges.body: Only approved calls execute. If one call is denied, preserve a result for it and never silently widen authority.
edges.payload: Validated operations bound to decisions and input hashes.

edges.label: model observations
edges.body: For model-originated actions, paired observations and mutation metadata enter the next context view.
edges.payload: Tool results, artifact refs, workspace revision and usage.

edges.label: no-tool candidate
edges.body: A no-tool response is interpreted according to phase. Local discovery text escalates; a cloud final response must pass the evidence gate.
edges.payload: Completion candidate, phase and current verification records.

edges.label: repair / escalate
edges.body: Failed checks, missing evidence, or a local discovery completion update phase and continue within limits.
edges.payload: Failure observations, required checks and escalation reason.

edges.label: accepted / terminal
edges.body: Evidence supports completion, or policy requires an honest non-success terminal outcome. Persist the distinction.
edges.payload: Outcome, patch and check evidence references.

edges.label: route unavailable
edges.body: If the required route violates permission or budget, stop/pause rather than silently degrading the policy.
edges.payload: Blocked or budget-stopped reason.

edges.label: task limit
edges.body: Whole-task step/time/spend exhaustion bypasses further inference. No model request is required to announce the stop.
edges.payload: Limit status and retained partial-work evidence.

edges.label: interrupt / resume
edges.body: A durable human decision happens before effects. Resuming restarts the affected node, so revalidation must be safe.
edges.payload: Exact proposed operation and decision payload.

edges.label: configured tool
edges.body: An enabled MCP tool uses the same invocation policy/result contract and an existing client transport.
edges.payload: Filtered schema, call, server result or lifecycle error.

edges.label: restore / reference
edges.body: Checkpoint and artifact references reconstruct context and task continuity, not a filesystem rollback.
edges.payload: Serializable state and bounded retrieval references.

edges.label: record outcome
edges.body: Record operation status and full-output refs for inspection and ambiguous-failure handling.
edges.payload: Operation ID, outcome, timings, artifacts and mutation metadata.

edges.label: denial / escalation
edges.body: Denied or out-of-phase calls receive matched feedback. A local mutation request escalates without executing it.
edges.payload: Policy result, call ID and route reason.

edges.label: bounded recovery
edges.body: A recoverable inference/protocol failure updates counters and route eligibility. No malformed assistant call is silently left in the next provider request.
edges.payload: Failure evidence, charged attempt and explicit retry/escalation reason.

edges.label: missing checks
edges.body: Queue configured missing checks as host-originated operations and reuse authorization. Do not run verification commands through an ungoverned side path.
edges.payload: Typed check operation, current revision, origin and required policy.

edges.label: check evidence
edges.body: For host-scheduled checks, record evidence and return directly to the deterministic gate. A passing check does not require another model round trip.
edges.payload: Exit status, output artifact, checked revision and operation outcome.

edges.label: Result is Plan
edges.body: User-added relationship. Define its trigger, payload, and implementation contract.
edges.payload: User-defined payload.

edges.label: Insert Local Action
edges.body: User-added relationship. Define its trigger, payload, and implementation contract.
edges.payload: User-defined payload.

edges.label: Check if direction required
edges.body: If the queue suggest that cloud model need to review, judge, or revise plan, make cloud model query
edges.payload: User-defined payload.

edges.payload: User-defined payload.
